audience: A 27-year-old in Delhi who owns one bodycon dress for weddings and one pair of shapewear she hates, because by the second song it has rolled down to her hips.
insight: Every woman who has worn shapewear to a party has spent half the night discreetly yanking up a waistband that keeps rolling down.
device: a coral waistband: one band across the frame carries every line; while gravity wins, the words roll down off it; when the tiny loop clips on, the band locks and the words stay up
device_why: roll-down is the one thing everyone hates about shapewear; the band is a waistband, so the type itself shows the problem and the fix — and it sits exactly over the film's own captions

recall.what: Underneat High Waist Tummy Tucker Shorts
recall.does: a tiny loop clips the shorts to your bra so they don't roll down
recall.why: you can walk, spin and bend in a fitted dress and nothing moves

claims.text: the little loop on the shorts clips to your bra centre: 'instant… you're not rolling down today'
claims.source: Underneat's how-to film for the High-Waisted Tummy Tucker Shorts (product page video)

claims.text: seamless, no-show finish, invisible under clothing

music.title: Shararat (From "Dhurandhar")
music.artist: Shashwat Sachdev, Madhubanti Bagchi & Jasmine Sandlas
music.why: a cheeky Bollywood dance number (shararat = mischief) for a cheeky brand; its preview builds with no kick until 12.75 s; the reel enters on a bar line 5.42 s in, so the drop lands as the loop clips on

look.why: a warm black stage (not another orange after Minimalist): the brand's coral lives only in the waistband band and the logo; the film's warm studio light glows against it

beats.shows: she rolls the shorts' waistband down like a cinnamon roll; the words on the band roll down with it
beats.serves: names the pain in one line every woman has lived

beats.says: gravity ko belly se pyaar hai.
beats.shows: she laughs at the camera holding up the high-waist shorts
beats.serves: turns the pain into the brand's own joke, and brings in the product

beats.shows: on the drop: the little loop held up, clipped to her bra centre, clipped to the shorts; the band locks
beats.serves: the one feature that answers the pain

beats.shows: she walks, spins and lunges; the waistband stays put
she stands in a fitted dress, smooth, hands on hips
beats.serves: lands the SMP as attitude: not today

beats.shows: the Underneat logo, the product name, the price, XS to 5XL
beats.serves: what to buy, what it costs, where, and that it fits
